Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中     China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及        integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business spans across
保健產品的生產、分銷及零售。本集團成立於二       manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
零零七年，現已發展成中國第五大醫藥製造商        products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into the
兼中國第三大醫藥產品分銷商。本公司於二零        fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturer and the third largest pharmaceutical
一六年十月在香港成功完成全球發售以來，已        distributor in China. In October 2016, the Company successfully completed its

數成份股、恒生可持續發展企業基準指數等多        Large Cap Index, constituent stock of Hang Seng Composite Large Cap Index
項資本市場指數，反映了國際資本市場對本集        and Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index, reflecting a global

的全方位肯定。                     performance, growth potential, market capitalization, and share liquidity.

前景與未來戰略                                OUTLOOK AND FUTURE STRATEGIES
隨著中國醫藥衛生體制改革的不斷深化，處於深                  China’s pharmaceutical industry is currently in a period of significant
度調整和變革時期的中國醫藥行業呈現出新時                   adjustment and transformation. With reforms continuing to deepen, the
代 特 色，結 構 優 化，質 量 升 級，監 管 趨 嚴，產 業      industry showed features of the new era in terms of structural optimization,
轉型加速，市場仍然存在巨大的發展空間和產業                  quality upgrading, stricter supervision, and accelerated industrial
整合空間，挑戰與機遇並存。本集團將堅持以市                  transformation. The market still has room for development and industrial
場需求為導向，以行業政策為引領，立足中國醫                  integration, and concurrently facing challenges and opportunities. Guided by
藥健康產業發展和變革機遇，鞏固核心優勢，挖                  the needs of market and industry policies, the Group will seize the opportunities
掘內生發展潛力，積極佈局產業鏈的核心領域和                  of development and reform in China’s pharmaceutical and healthcare industry,
核心環節，以併購整合與研發創新為引擎，優化                  consolidate its core advantages, explore its organic development potential, and
資源配置，推動業務調整和產業升級，實現主要                  actively plan for the core areas and core segments in the industrial chain. Also,
業務板塊的長期穩健可持續發展，持續鞏固與提                  as driven by merger and acquisition as well as R&D, the Group will optimize
升本集團在中國醫藥行業的領先地位。                      resource allocation, promote business modification and industrial upgrading,
                                       accomplish long-term steady and sustainable development of its major business
                                       segments, and continue to strengthen and enhance its leading position in

                              agenda for a regular meeting.

本公司暸解及認同董事會具備適當的所需技巧、                  The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of a Board with a balance

內部監控及風險管理                     INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT
董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管          The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board for
理及內部監控制度，以保障股東的投資及本公          maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control systems to
司的資產，並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險管         safeguard shareholder investments and Company assets and reviewing the
理及內部監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失提          effectiveness of such systems on an annual basis. The risk management and
供合理而非絕對的保證，並旨在管理而非消除          internal control systems can provide reasonable and not absolute assurance
在達致業務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。           against material misstatement or loss, and are designed to manage rather than
                              eliminate the risk of failure in the process of attaining business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系統，         The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and internal
並極為重視其製藥、醫藥分銷及藥品零售業務          control system, and devoted significant attention to internal control measures
的內部控制措施。其已採取嚴格的內部控制措          of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution and
施及經營程式，以監管從研發到生產、分銷及零         pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent internal control

統根據相關行業及管理標準（包括GMP及GSP要       value chain, from research and development to manufacturing, distribution
求）設計。本集團全面實施定期內部控制審計、         and retail. The Group’s internal control system is designed according to
內部風險管理及除錯防錯方面的各項程序。           relevant industrial and management standards, including the GMP and GSP
                              requirements. The Group fully implements the procedures for periodic internal
                              control audit, internal risk management, and error correction and prevention.

的綜合損益表、綜合全面收益表、綜合權益變動                   income, the consolidated statement of changes in equity and the consolidated

包括重大會計政策概要。                             financial statements, including a summary of significant accounting policies.

我們認為，該等綜合財務報表已根據香港會計師                   In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements give a true and fair view of
公 會 頒 佈 的《香 港 財 務 報 告 準 則》真 實 而 公 允     the consolidated financial position of the Group as at 31 December 2018, and

務表現及綜合現金流量，並已遵照香港《公司條                   (“HKFRSs”) issued by the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants
例》妥為擬備。                                 (“HKICPA”) and have been properly prepared in compliance with the Hong
                                        Kong Companies Ordinance.

意見的基礎                                   BASIS FOR OPINION
我 們 已 根 據 香 港 會 計 師 公 會 頒 佈 的《香 港 審 計   We conducted our audit in accordance with Hong Kong Standards on

          這些修訂處理三個主要範疇：歸屬條                    These amendments address three main areas: the effects of
          件對計量以現金結算股份支付之交                     vesting conditions on the measurement of a cash-settled share-
          易的影響；為僱員履行與以股份支付                    based payment transaction; the classification of a share-based

          具有淨額結算特質之以股份為基礎                     a certain amount in order to meet an employee’s tax obligation
          付款的交易的分類；及對以股份為基                    associated with the share-based payment; and accounting where
          礎付款的交易的條款和條件作出令                     a modification to the terms and conditions of a share-based
          其分類由現金結算變為權益結算之                     payment transaction changes its classification from cash-settled
          修訂時的會計處理。該等修訂釐清計                    to equity-settled. The amendments clarify that the approach
          量以權益結算股份支付之交易的歸                     used to account for vesting conditions when measuring equity-
          屬條件之入賬方法亦適用於以現金                     settled share-based payments also applies to cash-settled share-
          結算股份支付之交易。此外，該等修                    based payments. The amendments introduce an exception so
          訂引入一個例外情況，在滿足若干條                    that a share-based payment transaction with net share settlement
          件時，為僱員履行稅務責任而預扣若                    features for withholding a certain amount in order to meet the
          干金額的具有淨額結算特質之以股                     employee’s tax obligation is classified in its entirety as an equity-
          份為基礎付款的交易，乃整項分類為                    settled share-based payment transaction when certain conditions
          權益結算股份支付之交易。此外，該                    are met. Furthermore, the amendments clarify that if the terms and
          等修訂澄清，倘現金結算股份支付之                    conditions of a cash-settled share-based payment transaction are
          交易的條款和條件被修訂，令其成為                    modified, with the result that it becomes an equity-settled share-

    公允價值計量                                Fair value measurement
    本集團於各報告期末按公允價值計量其投                    The Group measures its investment properties, derivative financial
    資 物 業、衍 生 金 融 工 具 及 股 權 投 資。公 允       instruments and equity investments at fair value at the end of each
    價值乃於計量日期在市場參與者之間以有                    reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be received to
    序交易中出售資產所收到或轉移負債所支                    sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
    付的價格。公允價值計量乃基於出售資產                    between market participants at the measurement date. The fair value
    或轉移負債的交易發生在資產或負債的主                    measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the
    要 市 場（ 或 若 無 主 要 市 場，則 為 最 有 利 於      asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the principal market for
    資產或負債的市場）的假設作出。主要或最                   the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal market, in the most
    有利市場必須能夠讓本集團進行交易。資                    advantageous market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most
    產或負債的公允價值乃採用市場參與者為                    advantageous market must be accessible by the Group. The fair value
    資產或負債定價時將採用的假設計量，即                    of an asset or a liability is measured using the assumptions that market
    假設市場參與者按其最佳經濟利益行事。                    participants would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that
                                          market participants act in their economic best interest.

    非金融資產的公允價值計量乃計入市場參                    A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account
    與者透過以最高及最佳方式使用資產或透                    a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using
    過將資產出售予將以最高及最佳方式使用                    the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market
    資產的另一名市場參與者而能夠產生經濟                    participant that would use the asset in its highest and best use.
    利益的能力。

    本集團採用適用於具體情況且具備充分數                    The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the
    據以供計量公允價值的估值技術，以盡量                    circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure fair
    使用相關可觀察輸入數據及盡量避免使用                    value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and minimising
    不可觀察輸入數據。                             the use of unobservable inputs.

    作為出租人                                     As lessor
    本集團根據經營租賃安排租賃其投資物                         The Group leases its investment properties (Note 15) under operating
    業（ 二 零 一 七 年：一 年 至 十 一 年）（ 附 註            lease arrangements, with leases negotiated for terms ranging from one
